observations.observation: Read the whole candidate. Data screening/merging, clustering-based imputation and normalization precede an ROI measure that combines benefit/cost with urgency, explicitly bringing charitable need into the objective. PCA chooses attributes and AHP supplies weights. The one-year portfolio model selects fourteen schools; the five-year extension adds prediction and timing/amount choices and selects sixteen. These are different horizons, not an isolated accuracy improvement. Sensitivity varies school count, funding constraints and equal allocation. The closing admits subjectivity while claiming adaptable use after training. Screening/deleting data is the author's described study method; this reading performs no deletion. Office/form fields remain and several word-wrap breaks need literal source repair. No statistical/optimization correctness, formulas/figures or source completeness accepted.
